events.name: New Jersey Devils at Detroit Red Wings

headlines.description: — Jack Hughes scored on a breakaway off a slick pass from Jesper Bratt early in overtime, lifting the
headlines.shortLinkText: Jack Hughes scores on a breakaway in OT, lifts Devils to a 5-4 win over Red Wings

events.name: Florida Panthers at Columbus Blue Jackets

headlines.description: — Brady Tkachuk had a natural hat trick in the second period, his brother Matthew Tkachuk matched a club record with five assists and the Florida Panthers rolled past the Columbus Blue...
headlines.shortLinkText: Brady Tkachuk has natural hat trick, brother Matthew has 5 assists as Panthers roll Blue Jackets 7-3

headlines.description: — Zachary Bolduc scored the decisive goal in a shootout for the second straight game, and the Montreal Canadiens beat the Buffalo Sabres 4-3 after blowing a two-goal lead Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Zachary Bolduc scores decisive goal in shootout for 2nd straight game as Canadiens beat Sabres 4-3

headlines.description: — Andrei Svechnikov scored two goals, including the winner with 6:04 left in the third period, to lead the Carolina Hurricanes to a 4-2 win over the Washington Capitals on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Svechnikov scores 2 goals to lead the Hurricanes to a 4-2 win over the Capitals

headlines.description: — Bobby McMann scored a goal in regulation and then added the game-winner in the fifth round of the shootout as the Seattle Kraken beat the Philadelphia Flyers 3-2 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kraken beat Flyers 3-2 in shootout as Philadelphia’s winless start reaches 8 games

events.name: Tampa Bay Lightning at New York Rangers

headlines.description: — Alexis Lafreniere scored twice and Dylan Garand made 25 saves as the New York Rangers beat the Tampa Bay Lightning 4-1 on Tuesday night for their fifth straight home win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alexis Lafreniere scores twice as Rangers beat Lightning 4-1

events.name: St. Louis Blues at Ottawa Senators

headlines.description: — Pius Suter, Jake Neighbours and Mason McTavish each had a pair of goals to lead the St. Louis Blues to a 7-2 win over the Ottawa Senators on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Suter, Neighbours and McTavish score 2 each as the Blues rout the Senators 7-2

events.name: Vancouver Canucks at New York Islanders

headlines.description: — Kyle Palmieri scored twice, Matias Maccelli added his first goal for New York and the Islanders beat the Vancouver Canucks 3-2 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kyle Palmieri scores twice as Islanders beat Canucks 3-2

headlines.description: — Teuvo Teravainen and Roman Kantserov scored two goals apiece, and the Chicago Blackhawks topped the Pittsburgh Penguins 5-3 on Tuesday night in Connor Bedard's
headlines.shortLinkText: Teuvo Teravainen helps the Blackhawks beat the Penguins 5-3 in Connor Bedard's season debut

headlines.description: — Cole Perfetti scored a pair of goals, Mark Scheifele had a goal and two assists, and the Winnipeg Jets beat the Minnesota Wild 5-2 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jets beat the Wild 5-2 as Cole Perfetti scores 2 goals

headlines.description: — Martin Necas scored two goals, including a 5-on-3 score, and the short-handed Colorado Avalanche beat the Dallas Stars 3-2 on Tuesday night in the opener of a home-and-home series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Martin Necas has 2 goals to lead the short-handed Avs past the Stars, 3-2

events.name: Vegas Golden Knights at Nashville Predators

headlines.description: — William Karlsson scored for the second straight game to put Vegas ahead, and the Golden Knights beat the Nashville Predators 5-2 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: William Karlsson has go-ahead goal and Golden Knights beat Predators 5-2 for 3-1 road record

events.name: Toronto Maple Leafs at Utah Mammoth

headlines.description: — Dylan Guenther and Mikhail Sergachev each had a goal and an assist in the second period to help the Utah Mammoth beat the Toronto Maple Leafs 5-4 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Guenther and Sergachev each have goal and assist in Mammoth's 5-4 win over Maple Leafs

headlines.description: — Martin Pospisil scored the tiebreaking goal with 4:22 left, Yegor Sharangovich added an empty-netter with 1:22 remaining and the Calgary Flames beat the Anaheim Ducks 4-2 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pospisil's tiebreaking third-period goal pushes Flames to first win of the season, 4-2 over Ducks

events.name: Edmonton Oilers at Los Angeles Kings

headlines.description: — Connor McDavid had a goal and two assists in the dynamic first period of his four-point night, propelling the Edmonton Oilers to a 4-1 victory over the winless Los Angeles Kings on Tuesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Connor McDavid's 3-point first period propels Oilers past winless LA Kings 4-1 for 5th straight win

events.name: Boston Bruins at San Jose Sharks

headlines.description: — Charlie McAvoy scored in his season debut after serving a six-game suspension and the Boston Bruins beat the San Jose Sharks 6-3 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: McAvoy scores in his 1st game back from a suspension to lead the Bruins past the Sharks 6-3
